title: applied/1: what apply did with one Result, uploaded by apply: each Effect it met, in the order applied, with what was read back as a code, and the finding/1 of each Finding it posted, with its surface's key as read back, and each ruling the owner made on a Finding, accepted or rejected, on which the Kernel resolves a Lens's thread through the queue App (issue 389). A body stays in the Result, which run names; a posted Finding is the record of finding/1, held by its own rules.

type.$comment: effect/1's types, which a Result may ask for, and approve, which none may: the approving act's one write (issue 195, ruling 5). tests/test_approve.py holds the two lists together. And open_pull_request, keyed by the pull request's number as read back, which binds a pull request the Factory opens to the issue its Run serves (issue 342); apply's open Effect, which writes it, lands in slice 2 with push.

rulings.description: The owner's decision on each Finding its Result decided, in the Result's order: the Finding, the thread it is on, and the result. The Lens's latest ruling on a thread, read whole, is the one the queue App's resolution closes it on. A record of a Release before issue 389 has none: it ruled on nothing, and so closes nothing, which is the reading that fails closed
